scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && mkdir -p dist/client && cp client/index.html client/styles.css dist/client/
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && tsx watch server/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
